$comment: Shell 'coverage' gate for the akmods fork. kcov cannot measure this repo's real logic (it lives in Justfile recipes and in container-only build scripts), so the gate measures what actually protects the fork: the share of testable patches in FORK-PATCHES.md that carry a `# covers: <id>` tag on a bats test in tests/unit. Enforced by scripts/coverage-gate.mjs via .github/workflows/coverage-gate.yml. 'measured' was 8/8 active non-exempt patches on the commit that introduced this file. Floors only go up; a human edits this file. Add a patch to FORK-PATCHES.md without a test and the gate fails unless you list it in `exempt` with a reason.

exempt.P3: README prose; no behaviour to assert.
exempt.P5: New fork-local files; each part runs under its own required check (bats, node --test, policy-check, actionlint).
